call_points.text: FY26 sales reached ₹5,090 Cr, up 14.5% YoY led by double-digit growth in all four business segments.
Transportation & Electronics division generated ₹1,846 Cr (36% mix) with 10.1% YoY growth.
Safety & Industrial division grew 16.0% YoY to ₹1,640 Cr, accounting for 32% of total sales.
Healthcare delivered the highest growth rate among divisions, up 17.5% YoY to ₹1,017 Cr.
Consumer division revenue expanded 15.6% YoY to ₹537 Cr, contributing 11% of sales mix.
PBT before exceptional items reached ₹960 Cr, expanding 1.6 percentage points YoY to 18.7% of sales.
Company generated ₹483 Cr in pre-dividend cash flow during FY26.

tax_litigation.opposing_party: Faceless Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department
tax_litigation.status: We have received final assessment order for FY 2021-22 wherein the assessing officer has made adjustments to the taxable income of the Company on transfer pricing grounds. The total tax demand raised on account of these adjustments is INR 44.72 Crs. We will be filing an appeal with Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, Bengaluru.

tax_litigation.opposing_party: Faceless Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department
tax_litigation.status: We have received final assessment order for FY 2022-23 wherein the assessing officer has made adjustments to the taxable income of the Company on transfer pricing grounds. The total tax demand raised on account of these adjustments is INR 41.32 Crs. We will be filing an appeal with the Commissioner (Appeals), Income Tax Department.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal filed with Joint Commissioner (Appeals), LGSTO 020 -Bengaluru: DGSTO-1 for FY 2017-18
tax_litigation.status: We have received favourable order wherein the demand raised by Assistant Commissioner of Commercial Taxes (Audit-1.6), Bengaluru, for difference in rate of GST paid on Royalty, amounting to INR 1.68 Crs, has been set aside and deleted. This is a favorable order and no further action is due from the Company.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal filed with Commissioner (Appeals - I), Central Tax, Pune, Maharashtra for FY 2018-19
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Commissioner (Appeals - I), Central Tax, Pune, Maharashtra
tax_litigation.status: We have the recieved the Order in Appeal, dated 14 November 2025, wherein the Commissioner (Appeals-I), Central Tax, Pune, has upheld the additional GST liability in respect of difference between GST liability as per GSTR 1 return filed by the Company and E-way bill data of the Company for FY 2018-19. The amount of additional tax liability under this Appeal is INR 4.74 Crs. The Company will be filing an appeal to the Tribunal against this order.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal filed with Additional Commissioner (Appeals - I), Central Tax, Pune, Maharashtra for FY 2020-21
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Additional Commissioner (Appeals - I), Central Tax, Pune, Maharashtra
tax_litigation.status: We have the recieved the Order in Appeal, dated 5 December 2025, wherein The Additional Commissioner (Appeals-I), Central Tax, Pune, has upheld the additional GST liability, amounting to INR 16.97L, in respect of input tax credit availed by the Company for FY 2020-21. We have opted not to litigate further given the amount involved.

We have received Adjudication Order dated 23 December 2025, wherein the Deputy Commissioner, LTU, Bengaluru has assessed additional GST payable on Royalty payment made by the Company and input tax credit availed for FY 2021-22, amounting to INR 1.18Crs. The Company will be filing an appeal against the same.

tax_litigation.opposing_party: Principal Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise, Chennai North Commissionerate, Chennai
tax_litigation.status: We have received Adjudication Order dated 30 December 2025, wherein the Principal Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise, Chennai, has assessed additional GST payable, amounting to INR 38.67Crs, in respect of inter-state cross-charges and input tax credit availed by the Company for FY 2018-19 to FY 2023-24. The Company will be filing an appeal against the same.

tax_litigation.opposing_party: Centralized Processing Center, Income tax Department, Bengaluru
tax_litigation.status: Intimation order under section 143(1) of Income Tax Act, 1961 ("IT Act") was issued on 3 March 2026 wherein following two issues are noted: a) Credit for TDS, amounting to INR 8,382,472, in the name of 3M Electro and Communication India Private Limited has not been granted. b) Interest under section 234C, amounting to INR 16,293,721, has been charged for delay in deposit of advance tax. The Company had initiated the advance tax payment on time, however, due to a technical issue in the interface between the bank and the Income Tax Portal, the said payment got returned back to the Company’s bank account. On noticing the same, the Company again initiated the above payment, however, the due date for payment of advance tax had already passed. The above two issues have led to demand of INR 80,22,280. The Company has filed appeal before CIT(A) on 1 April 2026.

tax_litigation.opposing_party: Principal Commissioner of Income Tax - 2, Bengaluru
tax_litigation.status: We have received order under section 263 of the IT Act proposing disallowance of donation, of INR 3,950,000, claimed under section 80G of the IT Act. The Company will await the consequential order section 143(3), read with section 263, of the IT Act and then decide upon the next course of action.

tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner, Ward 203 & 204 (KCS), Vyapar Bhawan, IP Estate, New Delhi - 110002
tax_litigation.status: We have received order under section 74 of CGST Act, 2017, demanding tax, interest and penalty, amounting to INR 10,359,938, for excess claim of input tax credit based on mismatch between Form GSTR 2A and Form GSTR 3B for FY 2018-19.

We have received Adjudication Order dated 30 December 2025, wherein the Principal Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise, Chennai, has assessed additional GST payable, amounting to INR 38.67Crs, in respect of inter-state cross-charges and input tax credit availed by the Company for FY 2018-19 to FY 2023-24. The Company had filed an application for rectification of the above order and now the order rejecting rectification has been received. The Company is evaluating filing an appeal against the same.

The Company has received favorable order from the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, Bangalore, for the FY 2007-08 and 2008-09, wherein the transfer pricing adjustment made by the tax department in relation to the margin of healthcare business segment has been struck down.

The Company has also received favorable order from the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal, Chennai, in the case of 3M Electro & Communications India Private Limited, for FY 2010-11 and 2011-12, wherein the transfer pricing adjustment by way of disallowance of support service fee and Royalty expense, has been struck down.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Rectification of appeal order filed with Jt. Commissioner of Sales Tax (Appeals - 1), Pune
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Sales Tax, PUN- VAT-E-623, Pune
tax_litigation.status: We have received Assessment Order dated 26 July 2021, wherein the Deputy Commissioner of Sales Tax, PUN- VAT-E-623, Pune, has incorrectly assessed additional interest payable of Rs. 15,44,110. The Company had filed an application for rectification of the above order and now the order rejecting rectification has been received. The Company has filed an appeal against the same with the Maharashtra Sales Tax Tribunal.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal filed with Commissioner of Central Tax GST Appeals - II, Bengaluru
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Central Tax, North Division-1, Bengaluru GST North Commissionerate, Bengaluru
tax_litigation.status: We have received order dated 27 January 2023, wherein the Additional Commissioner (Appeals) has rejected the Company's appeal filed against the order of the Joint Commissioner of Central Tax, North Division-1, Bengaluru GST North Commissionerate, Bengaluru, that has incorrectly assessed additional GST and penalty payable of Rs. 20,647,650 on account of incorrect classification of Handrub range of products. The Company is in the process of filing an appeal against the same with the Bengaluru GST Appellate Tribunal.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,399.24 Cr (+16.8% YoY), net profit ₹215.34 Cr (+201.7% YoY).
3M India Limited’s Board, led by Pratap Rudra Bhuvanagiri, recommended a final dividend of ₹506 (₹160 final + ₹346 special) per share for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on August 2026.
3M India presented FY26 performance showing 14.5% sales growth to ₹5,090 Cr and ₹960 Cr pre-exceptional PBT.

3M India announced the 2nd Amendment Agreement to its healthcare distribution and manufacturing agreements, extending continuing product terms to 7 years and receiving US$13 million compensation from Thermo Fisher.
